messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for streaming-api.prod (eu-west-1). p99 ~1200ms over last 3m. Auto-paging on-call.

sre-jamie: taking this, oncall here. starting quick triage.

platform-ash: seeing queue depth spike on shard-3, CPU on 3/4 pods at ~95%.

infra-raj: no pod restarts in last 10m. node metrics show elevated iowait on node-n3.

sre-jamie: checking dashboards — top model variant `gpt-x-13b-q4` p99 jumped. KV cache hit rate down ~18%.

sre-jamie: quick prometheus check:
```
increase(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="streaming-api",le="1.0"}[5m])
```

platform-ash: can route traffic off shard-3 to eu-fallback group, ready to execute if approved.

product-lee: CS note: partner batch `batch-44` is seeing timeouts, customer-impact confirmed, CS already pinged.

sre-jamie: plan: 1) route-shift shard-3 -> eu-fallback, 2) scale streaming pool +2 replicas, 3) if still high, fallback to smaller model variant.

eng-ops: executing route shift -> `./tools/route-shift --group eu-fallback --shard shard-3`

eng-ops: route-shift complete. monitoring... p99 trending down.

eng-ops: update: p99 dropped from ~1200ms -> ~320ms within ~90s :thumbsup: 

platform-ash: KV cache eviction events spike at 18:01 UTC, correlates with a canary rollout that finished ~17:58. might be root cause.

infra-raj: confirmed node-n3 iowait persists, opening host ticket with infra provider for deeper investigation.

sre-jamie: leaving route-shift + scale in place for now. will monitor 30m and file a follow-up incident investigation for root cause and rollback analysis. tagging @product-lee for customer comms.

product-lee: sending customer update now. will include mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-4529, assigned to @sre-jamie. Status: mitigated (live mitigation applied).

sre-jamie: closing live mitigation phase — p99 stable ~310-350ms. handing to oncall for postmortem and RCA: please pick this up, @eng-oncall-next. :white_check_mark:
